name: Background Effects
summary: Background effects are decoration: a grid backdrop, two gradient bars, a recolored scrollbar and a slow pulse. Use them to give a surface texture without adding an element or a role. Text on a gradient still needs 4.5:1 at its worst point, and a recolored scrollbar is still a control.
demoNote: Switch themes in the header and watch example 3's failing bar change its verdict. Turn on Reduce motion and both swatches in example 5 stop.

contract.useWhen: Background decoration, and the accessibility rules that come with it.
keyboard: moves onto the scroll region, which is a tab stop whether or not you gave it one
native: scroll the focused region by a line
native: jump to the top or the bottom of the focused region
failureModes: fx-grid on a host with no isolation:isolate, so the z-index:-1 backdrop paints behind it
a gradient sampled at its endpoints, which are two corners nobody puts text in
decoration carrying meaning on its own, which forced colors deletes outright
two motion gates with different reach — gate through the token, not the selector
